name: Occupancy Dual Contouring
definition: A surface extraction method that constructs a mesh from a binary occupancy grid by locating vertices at grid edges and solving a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) to determine vertex positions, using dual contouring principles to handle complex topology.
summary: Occupancy Dual Contouring extracts high-fidelity meshes from binary grids using dual contouring and QEF optimization, avoiding distance data to handle complex topology via GPU-parallelized searches.
